messages.content:
An Apache access log contains this line:
127.0.0.1 - - [23/Nov/2026:10:14:22 +0100] "GET /download?file=..%2f..%2f..%2f..%2fetc%2fpasswd HTTP/1.1" 200 1832
Name the class of web vulnerability this request is attempting to exploit.

message.content:
**Path Traversal (Directory Traversal)**, a form of **Local File Inclusion / Arbitrary File Read** vulnerability.

The URL-decoded path is:

```
/download?file=../../../../etc/passwd
```

The attacker uses the `../` sequences (URL-encoded as `%2f`) to escape the intended download directory and traverse up to the filesystem root, attempting to read the sensitive `/etc/passwd` file. The **200 status code with 1832 bytes returned** suggests the attempt may have succeeded.
